mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VIDEOS (user_id, team_id, meal_type, meal_date, video_url, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{teamId}, #{mealType}, #{mealDate}, #{videoUrl}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.user_id AS userId, u.nick_name AS uploaderNickName, v.team_id AS teamId, v.meal_type AS mealType, v.meal_date AS mealDate, v.video_url AS videoUrl, v.description, v.created_at AS createdAt FROM VIDEOS v JOIN USERS u ON v.user_id = u.id WHERE v.team_id = #{teamId} AND v.meal_date = #{mealDate}
